confirmedFindings.title: Permanent restart strategy on failing worker risks supervisor crash loop
confirmedFindings.body: Setting restart: :permanent for a worker that terminates on transient network errors will exhaust supervisor max_restarts (3 in 5s) and crash the supervisor hierarchy.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use restart: :transient or :temporary so normal or handled error exits do not trigger endless restarts.
